caption: One continuous high-motion skatepark sequence in the same concrete bowl under clear afternoon light. The invariant subject is the same skateboarder wearing a red hoodie, black helmet, dark pants, and white sneakers, riding the same natural-wood skateboard with black grip tape. The invariant environment is the same graffiti-marked concrete skate bowl with metal railings and spectators in the far background.
invariant_caption: The same skateboarder in a red hoodie and black helmet rides the same wooden skateboard through the same concrete skate bowl.
contrast_caption: A different rider, bicycle, scooter, snowboard, street, or indoor gym replaces the skateboarder and skate bowl.
